name: Weather Scout
tagline: A three-day go / marginal / no-go weather outlook for launches at the big US spaceports
description: Name Vandenberg, the Cape, Starbase or any other pad, and it reads public forecasts and model output to grade the coming 72 hours for a launch commit. Each day lands on a three-step scale, with the reasoning shown. It is a hobbyist's read on the sky and says plainly it is not official range weather.
author: AdeptusMec71933
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
